previousEvidence.boundary: Retained unchanged. Its earlier whole-application results do not verify later operator helper changes.

reviewedScope: New Oracle endpoint authorization, signature/decision boundaries and aggregate resource bounds
CLI operation selection, overwrite risk, private configuration and network guards
Package/artifact identity, startup instructions and manual dependencies

findings.issue: Unknown rollback flag could be ignored while --apply selected promotion
findings.fix: Shared strict parser rejects unknown, duplicate, missing and positional arguments before provider/signing. Expected identity format checked before RPC.

findings.issue: Measurement JSON/CSV could overwrite earlier exports or operator inputs
findings.fix: Require a fresh .json output pair, reject existing JSON/CSV before RPC and create files with exclusive writes. CSV uses standard escaped quoting.

findings.issue: Operator RPC transport lacked an explicit HTTP request timeout
findings.fix: Both CLIs set a 10-second FetchRequest timeout. This is not an overall command or transaction-mining deadline.
findings.verified: Source inspection; no external outage experiment

rows.timingMeaning: Optional user-recorded submission to block timestamp; not finality, server latency or RPC receipt retrieval time

readOnlyReceiptMeasurement.limitations: Testnet observations, not mainnet price estimates. Missing L1 data fee is unknown, never zero. executionPlusKnownDataFee is not universally all-in (operator/other chain fees may apply). Rows are not an additive lifecycle; no finality assertion.

actualIsolatedCLI.scope: Explicit isolated chain 31337; no MongoDB, public deployment, hosted activation or Git writes

verification.reason: Only operator helpers changed; focused unit/actual CLI coverage and backend regression are proportional. Earlier browser/contract results retain their dated scope.

limitations: No new Slither run or Docker image build. No tools/environment were installed.
No hosted transaction, real email, public-chain deployment or accuracy experiment.
An overall transaction wait is not bounded by the per-request HTTP timeout.
Exclusive output writes preserve existing files, but an interrupted two-file export can leave only one newly created file; choose a fresh filename for retry.
manualDependencies: Brevo approved sender/private API key and inbox access
Dedicated testnet wallets, RPC/funding and deployment authorization
Hosting account rollout/settings and actual hosted workflow checks
